units: litres; 1 in-game day = 24 h from Sky Director

sources.rule: fill = table[weather] * (1 + GetWetness()) - so wetness up to doubles yield; gold funnels catch the storm; skull spout drains to channels
always flows, never empty, small base; daily d6 roll at dawn: 6 = sweet spring, x3 flow that day

thirst.player: thirst 0..100, +4/h (x1.5 in Clear daylight), drink 1 L = -35; >80 halves stamina regen; 100 = 1 hp/10 s
thirst.animals: unwatered 1 day: no milk/eggs; 3 days: animal leaves
thirst.herbs: unwatered herbs pause growth; Stormbloom grows only if the plant had rain that day

balance: spring alone (600 L/day) keeps player + 4 goats + 4 hens + 32 herbs alive (~70 L/day), and still covers the full capped herd (6 goats + 8 hens, see livestock.json) at ~87 L/day, so even a sour d6 morning never starves the island; the cistern feeds growth surplus and brewing. The island never dies of thirst; storms make it rich.
items: Item_OR_Waterskin_00..01 (2 L, refill at any source)
